content: Germolene is a trademark associated with a variety of antiseptic products manufactured by Bayer. Historically, Germolene was formulated as a thick antiseptic ointment characterized by its distinctive pink color. However, the brand name is now applied to a broader range of products, including creams, gels, liquid antiseptics, and other items such as antiseptic wipes. In some instances, Germolene liquid has been utilized in television production. Specifically, it is injected into food props to prevent actors from consuming them during filming. The invention of Germolene is credited to Sir William Henry Veno, who was also the creator of Veno's Cough Cure. Sir Veno eventually sold his company to the Beecham's Company.
